title: Ruppelt's study of sightings near nuclear sites

tellings.quote: Well, yeah, it would be Edward J. Pelt's original study where he came in that was done from 1947 1952 and then he wrote a book about it in 1956.

plain: Edward J. Ruppelt, who led the US Air Force's early study of UFO reports, is said to have looked into sightings around American nuclear sites in a study that ran from 1947 to 1952, and then to have written a book about it in 1956. Michels brings this up himself, without naming the book, in a 2025 episode where the skeptic Mick West is challenged to a debate. He offers it as early official evidence that UFOs took an interest in nuclear sites.
